automations.readOnlyMaster: Managed by the Default tenant — read-only
schedules.enabledHint: When off, the cron loop ignores this schedule entirely — no ticks, no history.
schedules.skipIfRunningHint: On each tick, skip devices whose previous execution hasn't finished yet. Prevents overlapping runs on slow hosts.
schedules.catchupHint: If the server was down during a scheduled tick, run it once the server is back (bounded by Max catchup runs).
schedules.assertPassTooltip: When the script exits non-zero, mark the device with a "Schedule Error" status and fire a notification. Leave off for pure-metric scripts where a non-zero exit is expected behaviour.
schedules.notifyOnceTooltip: Dedupe repeated failure notifications per device: one alert when it starts failing, silence until it recovers. Applies to Assert Pass alerts.
scripts.expectedExitCodeHint: The agent marks the execution as 'success' only when the script exits with this code (default: 0)
scenarios.export.leanDesc: Scenario only — references scripts by id
scenarios.export.copyJsonDesc: Lean export, ready to paste (e.g. into an AI chat)
scenarios.importJsonHint: Import a scenario JSON file (with or without embedded scripts)
scenarios.emptyTemplateHint: Download an empty scenario JSON to share with an AI / colleague
scenarios.pasteJsonHint: Paste an exported scenario (with or without embedded scripts).
scenarios.graphEditor.closeConfirm: Close the graph editor? Unsaved changes will be lost.
scenarios.import.conflictsHint_one: The import contains {{count}} script whose UUID already exists. Choose what to do for each.
scenarios.import.conflictsHint_other: The import contains {{count}} scripts whose UUID already exists. Choose what to do for each.
scenarios.import.keepExistingDesc: Don't touch the existing script. Imported nodes point at it.
scenarios.import.overwriteDesc: Replace the existing script body with the imported one.
scenarios.import.newCopyDesc: Insert as a fresh script with " (imported)" suffix.
scenarios.history.title: Run history — {{name}}
scenarios.history.empty: No runs yet. Trigger the scenario to create one.
scenarios.history.pickRun: Pick a run to see step-by-step output.
